name: Evoker's Horn
box: DEF 15 · MP +20 · INT +3 · Summoning Magic skill +5
House of the Hero — Windurst Walls (G-4), as Summoner main job
Lightning Pendulum · Daze-breaker Charm · Wind Pendulum
Cloister of Storms — The Boyahda Tree · Cloister of Gales — Cape Teriggan (F-5)
Lightning Gremlin (WAR) and Thunder Gremlin (RDM) · then Ogmios (Manticore)
intro: The third artifact quest, and the longest: two battlefields, two Pendulums and four trips back to Koru-Moru.
steps: As Summoner main job, examine the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls (G-4) to hear Carbuncle's cry for help. Zone first if you just finished another Carbuncle quest.
Talk to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls (E-7). The Rhinostery researcher he mentions is Ripapa.
Talk to Ripapa in Mhaura (I-9), on the upper level just east of the Porter Moogle, for the Lightning Pendulum.

Go to the Cloister of Storms in The Boyahda Tree. Boyahda Tree Home Point #1 is right outside it. Buff outside, summon your Trusts, trade the Lightning Pendulum to the Lightning Protocrystal and enter.
Kill the Lightning Gremlin and the Thunder Gremlin.
Back to Koru-Moru — he gives you the Daze-breaker Charm.
Talk to Agado-Pugado in Rabao (G-9) for the Wind Pendulum.
Go to the Cloister of Gales: Western Altepa Desert → Kuftal Tunnel (enter at H-4, cross to the north exit) → Cape Teriggan, the Cloister is at (F-5). Cape Teriggan Home Point #1 is outside it.
Trade the Wind Pendulum to the Wind Protocrystal and beat Ogmios.
Return to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls (E-7) for the cutscene and the Evoker's Horn.
Both Pendulums can be dropped once the fights are done.
fight: Gremlins: the Lightning Gremlin is a Warrior whose hits drain TP; the Thunder Gremlin is a Red Mage whose hits drain MP. Both resist Sleep and Repose. They hit hard and drain 1–40 per hit, and Stoneskin absorbs the damage but not the drain — a shadow tank is better. Kill the Thunder Gremlin first so your avatar keeps its MP.
Ogmios: a Manticore that spams Silencega and Dispelga — bring Echo Drops. Keep mages back, away from his AoE TP moves (Riddle in particular).
Buffs cast outside do not wear off when you enter either battlefield.
If you lose a fight you need a new Pendulum from the same NPC to try again.
changes: Trusts can be summoned inside both battlefields.
No Fame requirement anywhere in the quest.
Note: on retail the Lightning Pendulum can be blocked while Trial by Lightning is active. If Ripapa will not hand it over, finish Ramuh's trial first.
